title: Tauri desktop shell
summary: Tauri 2 shell for a sidecar-engine app: engine start/stop, OS file-open queue, single instance, update check/install, system fonts, display server and graphics backend, zoom, traffic lights, splash reveal, native renderer bridge. 26 commands.
description: Command handlers are registered in `main.rs` `generate_handler!`; plugins are shell, dialog, updater and single-instance. The engine runs as a packaged sidecar (`packaged.rs` finds the folder) and is stopped on the Exit event; launch arguments `--command <id>`, `--action <name>` and `--script <file>` are queued as runs for the page (`take_pending_runs`, `take_pending_opens`). B06 counts 23 commands; the source registers 26 because the nine `native_*` commands belong to the native renderer bridge (`native.rs`, which depends on the formvis-render crate, B06 row 35, not seeded). `main.rs` derives from the tauri-compiler-skill sidecar shell template (MIT, NOTICE.md). Frontend callers use `@tauri-apps/api` `invoke`.
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

commands.name: take_pending_runs
commands.doc: The runs that arrived before the page was ready; the page asks after it has opened the waiting files.

commands.name: take_pending_opens
commands.doc: The page registers its listeners and then asks for the files that arrived before it was ready.

commands.name: confirm_exit
commands.doc: The page has saved or discarded every unsaved document: the app may exit now. The engine is stopped by the Exit event.

commands.name: check_for_update
commands.doc: Help > Check for Updates: asks the update endpoints and says what it found, or why it cannot ask.

commands.name: install_update
commands.doc: Downloads and installs the update the last check found, stops the engine and restarts the app. The page settles unsaved documents first.

commands.name: system_fonts
commands.doc: The font families installed on this computer, sorted and without duplicates, for the Type tool's font list.

commands.name: system_fonts_english
commands.doc: The same list under each font's English family name (Preferences > Type > Show Font Names in English); a font with no English name keeps its first one.

commands.name: note_recent_document
commands.doc: Adds a file the person opened or saved to the system's recent documents (the desktop's recent list, the taskbar jump list, the Dock menu). A path that is not a file is ignored; the page calls it from its own recent list.

commands.name: pick_image_path
commands.doc: The native open dialog for a linked smart object's file (33.2): returns the file's real disk path, which the web view never learns from a picked File. None when the dialog is cancelled.

commands.name: file_dialog_report
commands.doc: The page asks for the report when a file dialog has not come back for a while.

commands.name: set_display_server
commands.doc: Keeps the display server choice for the next launch; other systems have nothing to set and accept it.

commands.name: set_graphics_backend
commands.doc: Keeps the native renderer's graphics API (auto, vulkan, gl, metal or dx12) for the next launch.

commands.name: native_start
commands.doc: Starts the native canvas in this window; returns the adapter's name and backend.

commands.name: native_stop
commands.doc: Stops the native canvas and drops its state.

commands.name: native_doc
commands.args: width: u32, height: u32, state: tauri::State<NativeState>
commands.doc: A new document of this size: the mirror starts empty.

commands.name: native_put
commands.doc: Pixels for a layer, as raw bytes (straight RGBA8, w by h at x, y in the layer's own lw by lh pixels); the id and geometry come as headers (x-id, x-lw, x-lh, x-x, x-y, x-w, x-h), so large images are not expanded into JSON.

commands.name: native_table
commands.args: id: String, red: Vec<u8>, green: Vec<u8>, blue: Vec<u8>, state: tauri::State<NativeState>
commands.doc: An adjustment's table: 256 values for each of red, green and blue.

commands.name: native_table3
commands.doc: An adjustment's 3D table as raw bytes: 52 by 52 by 52 nodes of straight RGBA8; the id comes as the header x-id.

commands.name: native_stack
commands.doc: Replaces the stack of layer specs the native document composites.

commands.name: native_remove
commands.doc: Removes an uploaded surface or table from the native document by id.

commands.name: native_present
commands.args: pan_x: f32, pan_y: f32, zoom: f32, checker_a: [f32; 3], checker_b: [f32; 3], checker_cell: f32, window: tauri::WebviewWindow, state: tauri::State<NativeState>
commands.doc: Draws the document at this pan and zoom (window pixels), over the checkerboard (colours 0 to 1, cell in window pixels), at the window's current size; true when the frame was shown.

commands.name: ui_zoom
commands.args: window: tauri::WebviewWindow, memory: tauri::State<Memory>, factor: Option<f64>
commands.doc: Preferences > Interface > Interface Scale for the desktop window: the page asks for a factor and the web view is zoomed to it, kept for the next launch; with no factor it only reads the zoom in effect.

commands.name: display_profile
commands.doc: The monitor ICC profile for the window: available, source, ICC data as text, byte size, a note and the monitor index.

commands.name: text_edit
commands.doc: macOS: sends undo, redo, cut, copy, paste or select-all to the focused web view field; other systems accept and do nothing.

commands.name: set_window_title
commands.doc: The page's title for the window: set, then the lights placed again, since AppKit lays the title bar out anew.

commands.name: app_ready
commands.doc: The page's first content is painted (dom.ts revealApp).

invariants.text: A new command is added to generate_handler! in main.rs, and a plugin API it uses is permitted in capabilities/default.json.
Files and runs that arrive before the page is ready wait in the queue until the page calls take_pending_opens and take_pending_runs; nothing is dropped.
Quit and close are handed to the page until it has settled unsaved documents and called confirm_exit.

examples.title: Handler registration
examples.snippet:
.invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
    take_pending_opens,
    take_pending_runs,
    confirm_exit,
    check_for_update,
    install_update,
    set_display_server,
    set_graphics_backend,
    system_fonts,
    system_fonts_english,
    pick_image_path,
    file_dialog_report,
    note_recent_document,
examples.whenToUse: Add a command name to this list when adding a #[tauri::command] fn.

examples.title: Call a command from the page
examples.snippet: if ('__TAURI_INTERNALS__' in window) void import('@tauri-apps/api/core').then((m) => m.invoke('set_window_title', { title })).catch(() => undefined);
